readings.label: national geopolitical entity
readings.definition: A political association with effective dominion over a geographic area.

readings.label: lagoon
readings.definition: A sheet of saline water separated from the open sea by sand or shingle banks. The sheet of water between an offshore reef, especially of coral and mainland. The sheet of water within a ring or horseshoe shaped atoll.

readings.label: sea beach
readings.definition: A landform consisting of loose rock particles such as sand, gravel, shingle, pebbles, cobble, or even shell fragments along the shoreline of a sea.

readings.label: obsolete lava field
readings.definition: A feature formed by cooled lava, the molten rock that is expelled by a volcano during an eruption.

readings.label: forested area
readings.definition: An area with a high density of trees. A small forest may be called a wood.

readings.label: sulfur spring
readings.definition: A spring whose water contains a significant amount of dissolved derivatives of sulfur.

readings.label: dry valley
readings.definition: A valley that no longer has a surface flow of water. Typically found in either Karst (limestone) or chalk terrain.

readings.label: buffer zone
readings.definition: A geographical region that serves the purpose of keeping two or more other areas (often, but not necessarily, countries) distant from one another, for whatever reason.

readings.label: ocean trench
readings.definition: Hemispheric-scale long but narrow topographic depressions of the sea floor. They are the deepest parts of the ocean floor.

readings.label: tidal watercourse
readings.definition: A watercourse which has the intensity and direction of its flow primarily determined by the tides.

readings.label: dell
readings.definition: A small wooded valley, either U- or V-shaped.

readings.label: hydroelectric reservoir
readings.definition: A reservoir constructed for the purpose of generating electricity.

readings.label: hummock
readings.definition: A patch of ground, distinct from and slightly above the surrounding plain or wetland. Often occurs in groups.

readings.label: apron
readings.definition: A gentle slope, with a generally smooth surface, particularly found around groups of islands and seamounts.

readings.label: soil
readings.definition: Soil is an environmental material which is primarily composed of minerals, varying proportions of sand, silt, and clay, organic material such as humus, gases, liquids, and a broad range of resident micro- and macroorganisms.

readings.label: muddy soil
readings.definition: Soil which is composed of a large proportion of mud, thus having properties resembling mud.

readings.label: nest of ant
readings.definition: A pile of earth, sand, pine needles, or clay or a composite of these and other materials that build up at the entrances of the subterranean dwellings of ant colonies as they are excavated. A colony is built and maintained by legions of worker ants, who carry tiny bits of dirt and pebbles in their mandibles and deposit them near the exit of the colony. They normally deposit the dirt or vegetation at the top of the hill to prevent it from sliding back into the colony, but in some species they actively sculpt the materials into specific shapes, and may create nest chambers within the mound.

readings.label: marine anoxic zone
readings.definition: Marine anoxic zones are areas of marine water that are depleted of dissolved oxygen. This condition is generally found in areas that have restricted water exchange. In most cases, oxygen is prevented from reaching the deeper levels by a physical barrier (sill) as well as by a pronounced density stratification. Anoxic conditions will occur if the rate of oxidation of organic matter by bacteria is greater than the supply of dissolved oxygen.

claims.claim: marine anoxic zone ⊑ marine water body

readings.label: marine warm-water sphere
readings.definition: The marine warm-water sphere describes a water mass extending to depths of ca. 800 to 1000 m in low and middle latitudes. It is separated from the marine cold-water sphere by the permanent marine thermocline

claims.claim: marine warm-water sphere ⊑ marine water mass
marine warm-water sphere ⊑ ∃adjacent to.permanent marine thermocline

readings.label: sandy sediment
readings.definition: Sediment characterised by an average particle diameter between 62.5 micrometers and 2 mm.

readings.label: mesophilic sediment
readings.definition: Sediment characterised by a temperature of 15-45 degrees Celsius and high-to-low oxygenation. Often impacted by hydrothermal fluid flows.

readings.label: indeterminate root nodule
readings.definition: Indeterminate nodules are found on temperate legumes like Pisum  (pea), Medicago (alfalfa), Trifolium (clover), and Vicia (vetch). They earned the moniker "indeterminate" because they maintain an active apical meristem that produces new cells for growth over the life of the nodule. Because they are actively growing, indeterminate nodules manifest zones which demarcate different stages of development/symbiosis.

readings.label: shrubland biome
readings.definition: A shrubland biome is a terrestrial biome which includes, across its entire spatial extent, dense groups of shrubs.

readings.label: montane desert biome
readings.definition: A montane desert biome is a desert biome which occurs in regions elevated above sea level and which has community structure determined by elevation-dependent environmental conditions.

readings.label: sedimentary stratum
readings.definition: A stratum is a layer which is composed of sedimentary rock or soil with internally consistent characteristics that distinguish it from other layers.

readings.label: dome swamp
readings.definition: A dome swamp is a swamp which occurs in a depression where deeper waters at the centre of the swamp allow  trees to grow taller relative to those in shallower regions of the depression. This creates a dome-like shape.

readings.label: tropical mixed needleleaf forest
readings.definition: A mixed needleleaf forest which is subject to tropical climate patterns.

claims.claim: tropical mixed needleleaf forest ⊑ mixed forest
tropical mixed needleleaf forest ⊑ needleleaf forest

readings.label: patio
readings.definition: A patio is a paved outdoor area, adjacent to a human house, and used for dining or recreation.

readings.label: material pooling disposition
readings.definition: The disposition of an environmental system to sequester and store some material entity.

readings.label: quartz glass
readings.definition: Quartz glass is a glass which is composed of silica in amorphous (non-crystalline) form.

readings.label: ionosphere
readings.definition: The ionosphere is a layer of the Earth's atmosphere which extends from about 60 to 1,000 kilometers above the planetary surface and is ionised by solar radiation. It includes the thermosphere and parts of the mesosphere and exosphere.

readings.label: motor
readings.definition: A motor is a machine designed to convert one or more forms of energy into mechanical energy.

readings.label: area of open water
readings.definition: An area of a planet's surface which is primarily composed of water in contact with an atmospheric column extending from the planetary boundary layer to the planet's exosphere with little to no physical obstruction.

claims.claim: area of open water ⊑ ∃part of.planetary surface

readings.label: solid environmental material
readings.definition: An environmental material which is in a solid state.

readings.label: photosphere
readings.definition: An astronomical body part which is composed of those parts of a star, distal from the star's core, from which light is radiated into space.

readings.label: tropical marine upwelling biome
readings.definition: A marine upwelling biome which is subject to tropical climate patterns.

claims.claim: tropical marine upwelling biome ⊑ marine upwelling biome

readings.label: water intake
readings.definition: A hydraulic-engineering installation which transports water - in specified amounts, of a specified quality, and in accordance with a water-consumption plan - from a source of supply into a conduit.

readings.label: shower fixture
readings.definition: A plumbing fixture within which a human or other animal may bathe under a spray of water.

readings.label: sediment permeated by saline water
readings.definition: Sediment which has its porespace filled by water with increased levels of sodium chloride and other salts.

claims.claim: sediment permeated by saline water ⊑ sediment

readings.label: environment associated with a plant part or small plant
readings.definition: An environmental system determined by part of a living or dead plant, or a whole small plant.

claims.claim: environment associated with a plant part or small plant ⊑ environmental system

readings.label: aerosolised liquids
readings.definition: An aerosol which has non-gaseous parts that are primarily composed of liquid droplets.

readings.label: aeolian lake
readings.definition: A lake which fills a basin that has been dammed by wind-blown sand,  formed between sand dunes oriented by winds; or formed by wind action under previously arid paleoenvironments.

readings.label: photoevaporation
readings.definition: A process during which energetic radiation ionises gas and causes it to disperse away from the ionising source.

readings.label: intrinsic magnetosphere
readings.definition: A magnetosphere which shields the body generating it from the stellar wind by withstanding the stellar wind's pressure before it reaches the body.

readings.label: convective storm
readings.definition: An atmospheric storm which is generated by the heating and convection of moist and unstable air masses.

readings.label: extra-tropical cyclone
readings.definition: A warm-core cyclone which occurs in the middle and high latitudes, primarily drawing energy from horizontal temperature contrasts between atmospheric fronts.

readings.label: liquid surface layer
readings.definition: A liquid surface layer which is in contact with air.

readings.label: estuarine open water upper water column
readings.definition: A layer of estuarine water which extends from the surface of the water column to the pycnocline or mid-depth and from a fiat boundary where the estuary bed below the water column reaches a depth of 4 meters until the end of the estuary most distal from the coast.

readings.label: freshwater seep riverine anchor ice
readings.definition: Anchor ice which is attached to a riverbed where a river flows into a marine water body and which is formed by the freezing of freshwater seeping out of the riverbed's sediments.

claims.claim: freshwater seep riverine anchor ice ⊑ anchor ice
freshwater seep riverine anchor ice ⊑ ∃located in.river bed

readings.label: cirrocumulus castellanus cloud
readings.definition: A cirrocumulus cloud which 1) has linearly arranged cumuliform protuberances which resemble crenellated turrets or towers, some of which are taller than they are wide in some portion of their upper parts, 2) possess a lower region or base which connects these protuberances.

readings.label: waterspout
readings.definition: A tornado which connects a cumulus or cumulonimbus cloud to a body of water, often transporting water from that water body along the spiraling winds constituting  its vortex.

readings.label: floeberg
readings.definition: An ice mass which is composed of a large amount of sea ice in the form of a hummock or a group of such hummocks, frozen together and separated from any surrounding ice by sea water.

readings.label: ice lead
readings.definition: A surface layer of a water body which has been formed as the result of surface ice fracturing and moving apart.

claims.claim: ice lead ⊑ surface layer of a water body

readings.label: synovial fluid material
readings.definition: A bodily fluid material which is composed primarily of synovial fluid, a bodily fluid secreted by the synovial membrane into the joint cavity to form a thin layer at the surface of cartilage.

claims.claim: synovial fluid material ⊑ bodily fluid material

readings.label: pollution control
readings.definition: A planned process during which the amount of pollutants released into an environmental system is regulated.

readings.label: cirque glacier
readings.definition: A small glacier contained within a cirque basin.

readings.label: methane gas emission process
readings.definition: A hydrocarbon gas emission process during which a portion of methane gas is transported into the atmosphere.

claims.claim: methane gas emission process ⊑ hydrocarbon gas emission process

readings.label: freshwater algal bloom
readings.definition: An algal bloom that is located in freshwater. Freshwater algal blooms are the result of an excess of nutrients, particularly some phosphates.

readings.label: concentration of hydrogen peroxide in water
readings.definition: The concentration of hydrogen peroxide when measured in water.
